name: Wojo Live Rosin | Swagyu
description:
Swagyu - 1g Live Rosin

No one on the corner had Swagyu like us.

Nothing compares to this unique mix of gas and earthy qualities.

The rosin jar's aroma hits you with the funky GG4 gas upfront, with a hint of undeniable meatloaf in there.

On the inhale it's nutty cookie gas, with that clean GG4 really coming in smooth on the exhale.

All while having this weird meaty funk lingering in the background.

The result is a strong high, which is great for pain and sleep relief.

The plant stays short but creates so many trichomes that its one of the sexiest buds in our portfolio and great in flower form on top of the amazing hash it makes.

Mother: Gorilla Nut 

Father: Meat Breath 

Effects: Snoozz, Heal

Flavor Profile: Gassy 

Bred By: Fresh Coast Seed Co
